assertion_review.archived_state_controls: Coordinate/state and physical/coupling-moment comparisons fail on different fixtures, support paths, basis conversion or archived fractions; the archive supplies the comparison values.
assertion_review.census: The required census is not independent: both expected and observed sets change together when the receipt declarations and rows are shortened; the empty-census counterexample passed.
assertion_review.closure: The algebraic four-term identity and cell/class sums check accounting consistency; closure alone cannot prove the independently integrated geometry is correct.
assertion_review.geometry_controls: Known concave area/moments, hole subtraction and signed-versus-geometric bow-tie values fail if orientation, holes or winding semantics regress.
assertion_review.paired_control: The live chord condition refuses absolute archived-target deficit ratios at or above 0.1; the saved audit deliberately refuses a false verdict. The hard-coded two-percent toy assertion is arithmetic, not an additional exercise of the live condition.
assertion_review.panels: PNG signatures fail for absent or non-PNG artifacts; scientific visual content was checked separately by opening both panels.
assertion_review.refinement_controls: Boundary relative L1 and quadrature-order-doubling bounds fail when the two independent resolutions/orders disagree above their thresholds.

findings.text: [P2] Pin the required case/rung census independently of the receipt: expected is currently formed from report['cases'] and report['rungs'], so shortening those declarations together with rows preserves the equality and skips omitted cases; validate accepted completed=true with cases=[], rungs=[], rows=[] and the two existing PNG panels. A control declaring one expected row but supplying none was refused, proving the validator executed. Fix by asserting the authored two cases and five rungs against independent constants and add a coherent omission/empty-census refusal, rather than only removing a row while retaining its declaration.
